purpose: Which dates EDGAR publishes no daily index because EDGAR does not receive, process or accept filings. Used ONLY by talonx_paperperf.form4_edgar to decide which daily indexes are expected; it never changes the forward tracker's run schedule.
weekend_rule: Saturday and Sunday are non-filing days (no daily index expected); pre-existing crawler behaviour, unchanged.

scheduled_closures.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

exceptional_closures_basis: SEC EDGAR News & Announcements (https://www.sec.gov/submit-filings/edgar-news-announcements) checked 2026-10-13: announcements shown through 2026-10-07 contain no 2026 EDGAR closure. The only exceptional closure listed (2025-12-24..2025-12-26, announced 2025-12-22) is outside supported_years. A future official notice must be added here as a new calendar version.

sources.statement: The EDGAR system will not receive, process, or accept filings in observance of the following federal holidays.
Indexes incorporating the current business day's filings are updated nightly starting about 10:00 p.m., ET; the process is usually completed within a few hours.

not_derived_from: the stock-exchange (XNYS) calendar or a generic federal-holiday library
